# Mechatron Lab Solutions — Software Development Company & Engineering Agency

> Enterprise software development company and engineering agency specializing in custom white-label OTT video streaming platforms, 9:16 vertical short-drama apps, and high-performance e-commerce architectures deployed directly onto client cloud infrastructure with zero SaaS rent and 0% commission.

## Core Value Proposition
- Complete E-Commerce Solution: Includes high-speed Next.js web store, cross-platform Flutter native mobile apps (Android & iOS), and All-in-One E-Commerce Admin Panel & CRM.
- 100% Client Infrastructure: Deployed directly onto client's private AWS, Google Cloud (GCP), Microsoft Azure, or VPS. No customer data or databases are hosted on shared servers.
- Complete Ownership: Full source code and unrestricted commercial IP rights available.
- Zero Platform Fees: 0% GMV revenue cut or per-transaction commission. Clients keep 100% of sales.
- Speed to Market: Pre-built and customized within 14 to 21 business days.

## Commercial Pricing Model
- Production-Ready Launch Package: $4,999 (one-time setup) | ₹3,99,000 in India. Includes customized storefront, Flutter iOS & Android apps published to stores, All-in-One Admin & CRM, cloud deployment, and 30 days warranty.
- Full Source Code & Commercial License: +$1,999 (one-time add-on) | ₹1,49,000 in India. Includes 100% unencrypted Git repositories, architecture documentation, and perpetual redistribution rights.
- Dedicated Developer Support: $20 / hour per developer | ₹1,500 / hr in India. Custom ERP/CRM integrations, custom checkout flows, and scaling.

## Operational Capabilities (Admin Panel & CRM)
- Multi-Warehouse Inventory: Allocate stock across multiple geographic hubs with automated dispatch routing based on customer delivery pincode.
- Smart Stock Alerts: Automated sales velocity calculation and 'Days of Stock' cover warnings before items run out.
- Real Profit & Loss Engine: Calculates true gross and net profit margin per order by matching supplier purchase invoice costs to sales prices.
- Visual Drag-and-Drop Page Customizer: No-code banner and product shelf management with independent desktop and mobile layout controls.
- Omnichannel Order Pipeline: Supports COD, UPI, Stripe, Cards, SMEPAY, and Bank Transfer with wholesale B2B dealer accounts.
